Title: Landing to login
Summary: Load public landing and open login
Expected Result: Landing is visible and login form is displayed

Title: Store registration required fields
Expected Result: Registration heading and required controls are visible; no submission occurs

Title: Prevent overselling
Summary: Reject a sale larger than available stock
Preconditions: Isolated test data with stock available
Steps: Request sale quantity greater than stock
Expected Result: Request is rejected and stock remains non-negative

Title: Exact stock exit
Summary: Allow an exit that consumes all remaining stock
Preconditions: Isolated unit test fixture with 5 units

Title: Sale reduces inventory
Summary: Create a sale with sufficient stock
Preconditions: Disposable PostgreSQL test database and approved tenant fixture
Expected Result: Sale is created and stock decreases by sold quantity

Title: Pending tenant login
Summary: Reject login for a pending tenant
Preconditions: Unit test fixture for pending tenant
Expected Result: Login rejects with pending approval status

Title: Reject invalid inventory transfer
Summary: Reject a transfer to the same branch or a non-positive quantity.
Preconditions: Isolated unit test fixtures for inventory transfer.
Steps: Request a transfer to the same branch; request one with quantity zero.
Expected Result: Both requests are rejected before committing the transaction.

Title: Sale reduces inventory
Summary: Create a sale with sufficient stock and verify the sale and stock update.
Preconditions: Disposable PostgreSQL test database and approved tenant fixture.
Steps: Authenticate; create a sale; query the resulting stock and receipt sequence.
Expected Result: Sale is created, receipt sequence advances, and stock decreases by sold quantity.
